author: rubikchat

sections.description:
AI chatbot for your website proven to increase conversions. Outsmart competitors with 24/7 customer support & improved satisfaction. Try AI Assistant for Free!

This plugin enables seamless integration of your RubikChat chatbot into your WordPress site. By leveraging RubikChat’s services, you can deploy a pre-trained chatbot on your website, utilizing the data you’ve uploaded to the RubikChat platform.

For more details regarding privacy and terms of service, please refer to our dedicated sections.
sections.faq:
How do I initialize my chatbot?

  1. Install the plugin on your WordPress website.
  2. Log into your RubikChat account and retrieve your Chatbot ID from the chatbot settings tab.
  3. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the “RubikChat” below the “Settings” menu.
  4. Paste the copied Chatbot ID into the designated field.
  5. Click “Save Changes” to complete the setup.
